summary: Frontend UI test of Base Year Emissions page redesign. All 3 requested features work: (1) Info banner removed, (2) 'Type' column with 'Organization'/'Facility' badges present after name column, (3) Scope 1&2 and Scope 3 base-year cards are clickable and correctly open Version History dialog for configured records (verified for ORG1 with FY 2017-2018 for Scope1&2 and FY 2020-2021 for Scope 3, and for Facility A with FY 2024-2025). Hover backgrounds (bg-blue-50/50, bg-purple-50/50 with darker hover) are applied via className.

issues: Minor: recharts warnings 'width(-1) height(-1)' and React 'key inside spread props' warnings observed on dashboard/hidden charts (pre-existing, not related to this change)

critical_code_review_comments: BaseYearEmissions.js is 3296 lines — should be split into smaller components (accordion row, scope card, dialogs) for maintainability.
Scope card onClick logic is duplicated between organization row and facility row (lines ~1712-1748 vs ~1914-1949); extract into a shared renderClickableScopeCard component to satisfy DRY.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing ORG1 org and facilities.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base Year Emissions page shows unified accordion with columns: [expand] [Name] [Type badge] [Scope 1&2 card] [Scope 3 card] [Status]. Clicking scope cards fires handleViewHistory (if configured) or handleEntityClick (if not, admin only). Version History dialog opens with role='dialog'. Setup dialog not tested for empty rows because the priority feature (clickability) already validated with configured records.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found; features implemented correctly.
